title: Unit 12 Test
subtitle: I’d like / Would you like…? · some / any · food & drink · in a restaurant

sections.title: A. Choose like or would like.

items.q: I ______ a cup of tea, please.
Do you ______ fish? — No, I hate it.
______ you like some cake? — Yes, please.
She ______ chocolate. She eats it every day.

sections.title: B. Write sentences with I’d like.

a: I’d like a glass of water
I would like a glass of water
I’d like a glass of water please
I would like the chicken salad
I’d like the chicken salad please
I’d like to see the menu
I would like to see the menu
I’d like to see the menu please

items.q: There isn’t ______ sugar in my tea.
I don’t want ______ dessert, thank you.

sections.title: D. Countable or uncountable? Choose a / an or some.
E. Complete the conversation in a restaurant. Choose the correct answer.

items.q: Customer: Yes. I’d like the soup ______ a starter.
Customer: Lagman, please. Waiter: Anything ______ drink?
Customer: Can I have the ______, please? I want to pay.

sections.title: F. Read the menu and answer the questions.
sections.passage: CAFÉ BAHOR — Starters: tomato soup 18,000 · green salad 15,000 | Main courses: plov 35,000 · chicken kebab 40,000 · vegetable lagman 30,000 | Drinks: tea 5,000 · fresh orange juice 12,000 · mineral water 6,000 | Desserts: ice cream 10,000 · honey cake 14,000

items.q: Which main course is for vegetarians?
There is coffee on the menu.
Honey cake is more expensive than ice cream.
